jobs.occupation: Internship / Master Thesis: Advanced Power Electronics & Hardware Design (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
Job description

In order to support Electrification Technologies department, Airbus Defence and Space is offering an

Internship / Master Thesis: Advanced Power Electronics & Hardware Design (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship or a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a Power Electronics Researcher (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Electrification Technologies department as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn
- Start: December 2026
- Duration: 5-6 months

Are you passionate about power electronics and eager to work on next-generation hardware designs? We offer a flexible and exciting opportunity – whether you are looking for an Internship or a Master Thesis. Join our team to design, simulate, and build innovative power electronic converter systems.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Research & Exploration: Investigate modern semiconductor devices (e.g., SiC, GaN)
and innovative converter topologies suited for high-performance applications.
- Simulation & Modeling: Use PLECS and LTSpice to model converter topologies,
analyze circuit behavior, and validate design concepts prior to prototyping.
- Hardware Design: Design and develop PCBs for power electronic prototypes, focusing on optimized layout for fast switching and low parasitic inductance.
- Prototyping & Testing: Assembly, testing, and initial operation of power electronic
circuits in the laboratory, verifying simulation results with real-world measurements.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student within Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering or a similar field of studies.
- A solid understanding of basic power electronics components and inverter topologies.
- Proven experience in PCB design and layout (preferably in KiCAD). This is essential for the practical aspects of the work.
- Proficiency and enthusiasm for circuit simulation using tools like PLECS and LTSpice, geared towards research and rapid prototyping.
- A proactive, curious, and analytical approach to problem-solving.
- Fluent communication skills in English and German.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

jobs.occupation: Digital Electronics Design Engineer (f/m/d) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Design complex digital electronic circuits for applications such as signal processing, instrument control, and data compression
- Develop high-speed digital electronics, including multi-gigabit serial links and high-speed memory-to-FPGA interfaces
- Verify circuit performance through simulation, including worst-case analysis, derating, and signal integrity analysis
- Supervise PCB layout activities for multilayer and rigid-flex high-reliability PCBs
- Test and validate your circuits in the laboratory as well as under extreme conditions during qualification and acceptance testing
- Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines, including mechanical design, radiation engineering, EEE engineering, manufacturing, and FPGA/IP core design
Your Qualifications

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering or a comparable discipline
- At least 5 years of professional experience in the design of digital electronics hardware, including FPGAs, microcontrollers, and high-speed digital interface standards such as JESD204, DDR memory, PCI, or Wizard Link, ideally in the space industry
- Experience in electronics design in accordance with applicable ECSS standards
- Knowledge of spacecraft communication interface standards such as SpaceWire, MIL-STD-1553, and SpaceFibre
- Experience with at least one programming language suitable for controlling automated test setups, such as Python or C/C++
- Experience with ECAD design and simulation tools, e.g. Siemens PADS Professional, Xpedition, Spice, or HyperLynx
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Your Tasks

- Manage / Support the preparation of proposals; inter alia (depending on the specific proposal, the candidate will have to either take full responsibility or only support the different tasks):
- Lead the proposal team towards the delivery of a proposals, on quality, time and cost
- Ensure that the proposal properly answer to the customer requirements; both formal requirements (conditions of tender, technical, programmatic, financial requirements, etc) and unofficial customer needs (technical, programmatic, financial, contractual, industrial, political, etc)

The candidate shall expect to face proposals of a large variety, in terms of contract value, vertical (EO, Navigation, Exploration, Telecom, Space Transportation, etc.) and customers (ESA, EC, DLR, other agencies, BW, commercial entities, etc.).
- Contribute to the organization and execution of in-house trainings on the proposal process

- Support the improvement of proposal processes, proposal quality and thus likelihood of proposal success

- Hard requirements:
- Completed studies (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or equivalent qualification (i.e. mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, physics)

- Strong experience in proposals management (3 years +) with Institutional customers
- Advanced knowledge of the MS suite (VBA coding, high-level skills with MS Word) and of advanced editing tools (Adobe, InDesign)
